C1172.title: Taobao Customer Information Illegally Crawled at 1.18 Billion Records
C1172.summary: A criminal judgment from the Suiyang District People's Court of Shangqiu, Henan, showed that the defendants illegally crawled Taobao customer information through web interfaces and obtained 1,180,738,048 records. The case highlights the platform user information security risks created by exposed interfaces, crawler programs, and bulk data collection.
